reasoned_conclusions.claim: Score cannot reconstruct test-first/test-after history from identical current code/tests alone.
reasoned_conclusions.basis: Score observes selected execution outcomes rather than historical ordering; distinct histories can lead to identical present inputs. Logical information limitation, not an empirical benchmark.

reasoned_conclusions.claim: Risk and expected useful information should be compared to execution/manual-review costs; glue/data/generated category alone does not determine value.
reasoned_conclusions.basis: Author recommendation conditional on actual behavior/risk and supported scope selection; no universal ROI, threshold or industry prevalence asserted.

reasoned_conclusions.claim: Detecting a selected change does not establish the original requirement is correct.
reasoned_conclusions.basis: Explicit finite manual counterexample20percent versus21percent with declared requirement10percent. Not a real tool-score claim.
